**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear sizing hints when a component ID is reused**

When a chart placed with content is removed via `remove_chart()`, its entry remains in `_sizing_hints`. If another chart is then added with the same explicit component ID but without content, this conditional leaves the old hint attached to the new chart. Sending the layout consequently checks the replacement against the removed chart's content, producing spurious warnings or preventing a valid dashboard save in strict mode. Remove the hint when deleting a component, or clear any previous hint when adding a component without content.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Check markdown against its current text before sending**

If a caller edits a markdown component through the returned handle's `meta["code"]`, the sizing check still estimates the original text captured in `_SizingHint`. For example, replacing a short automatically sized block with many paragraphs passes strict mode at the original small height even though the current text is clipped; shortening a block can conversely reject a correctly adjusted height. For markdown components, derive the estimate from the current `meta["code"]` when checking the layout rather than the placement-time snapshot.
